judgment_text:
Common Prayer:- Second Appeals filed under Section 100 of CPC, against the common judgment and decree dated 30.06.2009 in AS. No. 43, 40 & 41/2007 on the file of the learned I Additional Subordinate Judge, Trichy, confirming the order dated 10.11.2006 in OS. Nos. 1401/2004, 2513/1993 and 627/1996, on the file of the Principal District Munsif, Trichy.

The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

N. Mala, J.:— When the matter was taken up on 12.02.2026, there was no representation for the appellants. Hence, the Registry was directed to list the matter under the caption “for Dismissal” today [20.02.2026].

2. Even today, there is no representation for the appellants and therefore, it is inferred that the appellants are not interested in prosecuting the Second Appeals.

3. Hence, the Second Appeals are dismissed for non prosecution. No costs.
